hook.text: Broadcasting to millions of receivers. Each misses different packets. Fountain codes let all recover from any subset.

buildup.text: Fountain codes generate a potentially unlimited stream of encoded symbols from k source symbols.

discovery.text: Any k+ε received symbols suffice to decode. It doesn't matter which ones you catch—just that you catch enough.

twist.text: LT and Raptor codes are practical fountain codes. They encode and decode in near-linear time.

climax.text: Raptor codes power MBMS mobile broadcast and digital fountain systems for satellite file delivery.

punchline.text: Catch any subset. Decode the lot. Rateless and robust.

quiz.question: What makes fountain codes rateless?
options: They generate unlimited encoded symbols; any sufficient subset decodes
